article.story: FORT WAYNE, Ind. -- — Michael Houge's 15 points and 11 rebounds helped Oakland defeat Purdue Fort Wayne 74-65 on Wednesday night. Brett White II scored 13 points and added 11 rebounds for the Golden Grizzlies (13-10, 9-3 Horizon League). Tuburu Niavalurua finished with 13 points. Corey Hadnot II led the Mastodons (13-9, 7-4) with 22 points, six rebounds, six assists and two steals. Maximus Nelson added 15 points for Purdue Fort Wayne. DeAndre Craig Jr. also had 11 points. The loss ended a five-game winning streak for the Mastodons. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
